title: Is there a program/plugin/script to extract text and also import it later?

posts.author: Marston
posts.body:
I wanted to look at translation for some of my older games and was thinking of maybe hiring someone. However, since those people most likely don't have the RPG Maker engine and would prefer some Excel, Word or at least .txt files I was wondering if a program exists that could dump all text from events, maps and the database into an easy to read format and later on reimportat that changed text into the game again.
I found something like this for older engines as well as for the MZ, but nothing of the sort seems to exist for VX Ace. I found some things that would allow text dumps but nothing that allows an import later on to replace the text with the new one.
